summary: Push day, so the protein push comes from chicken breast at both lunch and dinner plus a fish-forward calamari swap is skipped in favor of chicken noodle soup for variety from the recent chicken-breast-and-rice streak. Lunch pairs a chicken pizza slice with extra grilled chicken and a rice/quinoa/bean bowl; dinner leans on chicken noodle soup, extra chicken breast, rice, bread and avocado.
